prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one universal “best” — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your case, how serious your injuries are, whether you need a trial lawyer, and how well you and the attorney communicate.

How to pick the best Chicago attorney for your car-accident claim
- Experience with car-accident and personal-injury cases (especially similar injuries or accidents).  
- Trial experience — important if your case may go to court.  
- Track record of settlements/verdicts for similar injuries.  
- Good client communication: who will handle the file (attorney vs. paralegal/law clerk), how often you’ll be updated.  
- Fee structure (most work on contingency—no fee unless you recover money).  
- Reputation: client reviews, peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers lists, state bar disciplinary history.  
- Comfort level after a consultation — you should feel heard and confident.

Well-known Chicago firms often used for serious car-accident/personal-injury claims
(you should still interview them — this is not an endorsement):
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Romanucci & Blandin  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard  
- Power Rogers (Power Rogers & Smith)

Practical next steps
1. If you haven’t already, get medical care and preserve evidence (photos, police report, witness info).  
2. Note the date — Illinois generally has a 2-year statute of limitations for personal-injury suits (exceptions apply), so don’t delay.  
3. Contact 3–5 firms for free consultations. Bring chronology, medical records, bills, insurance info, police report.  
4. Ask focused questions (see sample list below) and compare answers/chemistry.

Sample questions to ask at a consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What results have you achieved?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will an attorney or staff manage calls?  
- Do you take cases on contingency and what percentage/fees/costs are charged?  
- Do you try cases or mostly settle? How many trials have you done?  
- What is a realistic outcome and timeline for my case?  
- Can you provide references or recent client testimonials?

If you want, tell me:
- the ZIP code where the accident happened,  
- a brief summary of injuries/damages, and  
- whether you’ve already spoken to any insurers or lawyers —
and I can produce a short tailored list of attorneys/firms near you and a suggested shortlist to contact.
